title: Salmon with beetroot and watercress
summary: Salmon with beetroot and watercress is a british dinner built around salmon fillets and cooked beetroot, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets dry and season it. Prep cooked beetroot and watercress for Salmon with beetroot and watercress so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook salmon fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook cooked beetroot and watercress in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon with beetroot and watercress before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice salmon fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
